Name: NPC Path Displayer
Author: Akago
Description: Some notes about the mod. Right now, any movement that happens while an NPC is married is not included. Nor is the NPC movement on the Island. It also won't reflect any new or custom NPCs. If this proves to be something people like, I'll consider working more to add these components. For now though, it should accurately highlight all spots an NPC walks with the All setting, or the path of an individual NPC should they be selected. I also didn't add any way to change the key in game. You'll have to edit the togglekey option in the config file directly to change the key.

Downloads.Description: Just updating the manifest with the dependencies and the update key.

Manifest.Name: Path Display
Manifest.Description: This mod on activation will render boxes over any spots the NPCs will walk. Does not include the Island or marriage right now.
